activity_summary: You came out of the Two Gentlemen and did not name the part. Nothing was bought. The K was still only a K. You went on toward the reckoning with no number in the book.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Came out of the part and kept the column empty of a figure.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Closed the play and did not ask the part's name.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Carried the book in with the K and without a number.

entities.name: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
entities.context: Mentioned in Out of the gentlemen

facets.activity: Left the part and went to the reckoning

quotes.speaker: abel_garnish
quotes.text: The K is still a K.
